name: The shared clearing — live foundation pilot

players.name: Mira
players.motive: Build a reliable food supply and a safe meeting place. I care about companions surviving, but I need evidence before trusting a route.

claim.text: A traveller reported berries two steps west; I have not checked whether any remain.

players.name: Tovan
players.motive: Find useful food sources and learn which routes are worth the risk. I value independence and want others to recognize what I discover.

claim.text: I heard the eastern clearing has abundant food and is safe. This is only a report.

players.name: You
players.motive: Explore the clearing and decide whom to trust.
